scope: New finite executable model only; not a Java/SQL decompiler or pooled real-application calibration dataset.
observation: Complete modeled state including unvisited record and metadata, plus returned read value where present; serial normal execution, no faults or concurrency.
label: At least one mismatch in the fixed finite state/input product, computed by execution independently of feature extraction. One transformation/contract is one candidate.
relational_feature: crossed_conflict_fraction: fraction of reference event pairs whose order reverses AND whose declared cell accesses overlap with at least one write
fit: Fixed-prior-intercept ridge logistic regression, lambda=1; train-only centering; each family total weight one. No sign constraints, feature selection or threshold tuning.
numerics: Newton gradient tolerance remains 1e-10; Armijo objective comparison permits 8 floating-point ULPs to avoid rejecting sub-ULP descent near convergence. This repairs numerical termination, not prediction thresholds or model tuning.
split: Three leave-entire-mechanism-family-out development folds; keep all schedules/alias contracts/update variants of each template together. One authored synthetic source, not three independent projects.
stop: Exactly three arms times three folds, compared with each fold's training prior. Preserve failures or non-improvement. No tuning, DB execution or deletion deployment.
limitations: Hand-authored primitive IR and access summaries, deliberately selected contrasts and already-known ordering mechanisms; labels are finite-domain only. Alias contracts are explicit symbolic key relations, not inferred from sampled data. This is an interaction-representation experiment, not external validation.
